name: MACS J0611.8-3036 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0611.8-3036, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj061183036-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies first found by its powerful X-ray glow; clusters like this are efficient gravitational lenses, and Hubble surveyed them in search of bright, giant arcs made by more distant galaxies.

claims.text: MACSJ0611.8-3036 is a target of the Hubble snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters (program 12884), at RA 06 11 48.44, Dec -30 37 23.9
The survey targets very X-ray luminous clusters detected by MACS
Such clusters are highly efficient gravitational lenses; a goal is discovering bright giant arcs
